Coding agents can follow imports. What they don't know is what your team knows: "amounts here are in cents", "this table is read by the mobile app, keep old columns", "run the payment e2e after touching this". readfirst keeps that knowledge in one file next to the code and hands it out, file by file, at the moment someone is about to change something. [](/jeonghun917/readfirst/blob/main/docs/readfirstread.gif) No server, no account, no model calls. MIT. It reads your git checkout and .readfirst/map.json. What it caught Making maps for open source projects, a check for lines whose result is thrown away found real bugs. The ones already with their maintainers: saleor: an "only recalculate what changed" option recalculated every discounted price ([saleor/saleor19984](https://github.com/saleor/saleor/pull/19984)). wagtail: a superuser who submits a page for moderation got the moderation email about their own submission ([wagtail/wagtail14790](https://github.com/wagtail/wagtail/pull/14790)). Tandoor: a ?category= filter on an API endpoint never applied ([TandoorRecipes/recipes4917](https://github.com/TandoorRecipes/recipes/pull/4917)). mealie: a safety filter on households never applied; the maintainers fixed it ([mealierecipes/mealie8964](https://github.com/mealierecipes/mealie/issues/8964)). Start Any language; needs Node 20+. npx readfirst init agent ci a first map, your agents wired to it (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini, ...), the PR Action npx readfirst read <file before changing a file: its rules, risks, checks, tests and callers npx readfirst verify before you finish: run the checks for everything your branch changed Commit .readfirst/map.json. items.author: moon0917
items.descZh: readfirst 是一款针对 AI 编码代理的轻量级工具，旨在解决代理在修改文件时缺乏项目特定上下文的问题。它通过读取代码库中的 .readfirst/map.json 文件，在每次修改文件前提供该文件的规则、风险、检查和调用者信息，确保变更符合团队约定。该工具无需服务器、账户或模型调用，基于 MIT 许可开源；已在 saleor、wagtail、Tandoor 和 mealie 等至少四个真实开源项目中成功发现并修复了关键 bug。它支持 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、Gemini 等多种 AI 代理，适用于任何使用 Node 20+ 的项目，特别适合依赖 AI 编码的团队。

items.title: Show HN: I built a tool to turn 3 photos into a Chipmunks Dance video
items.desc: description: Three photos in, the Chipmunks Dance out: your trio takes turns up front in a vertical 9:16 clip. See what the AI does with each photo and what it costs. title: Chipmunks Dance AI: Make the 3Person TikTok Video From Photos image: https://chipmunksdanceai.net/videos/demos/chipmunksdancecase01poster.jpg Chipmunks Dance AI · 3 photos · 9:16Updated November 2026 Chipmunks Dance AI — Put Your Trio in the Trend Three photos in, the trio routine out. Your people take turns up front, in a vertical clip with the framing the trend uses. No rehearsal, no finding a day when all three of you are free. Chipmunks Dance · trio routine · 3 photos Left spot Left spotRequired · opening left dancer Front / center Front / centerRequired · opens the lineup Right spot Right spotRequired · opening right dancer 480p Full video\~811 cr Generate This template maps all three dancers in the opening lineup. For a filmed duo version, split the four handoffs between two people using the steps below. Independent tool — not affiliated with Bagdasarian Productions, the characters' rights holders, or the recording artists. Trending example Real Chipmunks Dance AI trio results from this generator — three photos, fixed 9:16 routine. Three Things to Know Before You Upload One clear, frontfacing photo per person Everyone in the photos is an adult who agreed to this Videos export as clean 9:16 MP4 — no watermark Make Yours in Three Steps — Chipmunks Dance Video Generator 1. One photo per person Three uploads, one each: who stands in the middle, who takes the left spot, who takes the right. Frontfacing, knees up or full body, even light. No sunglasses, no group shots, no faces turned away. 2. Pick the length, not the choreography Short covers the opening exchange. Full and Full HD run the whole routine. The routine itself is fixed on purpose — the handoffs land on the same beats every time, which is why a template can reproduce it and a freeform prompt can’t. 3. Download, then add the sound where you post You get a silent MP4\. Attach the track inside TikTok, Reels or Shorts, where the version you’re allowed to use is handled by the platform. That’s deliberate: baking a commercial recording into a file is the fastest way to get a post muted, and it follows you to every repost. Which Photo Goes Where — Chipmunk Dance AI This is the only real decision on this page, and it changes the video more than any setting: Middle opens the routine and comes back for a second turn — put whoever wants the spotlight there. Left takes the first changeover: the turn, back to camera, hands behind the head. Right takes the second: wide arm swings, straight at the lens. The finish is shared. The line closes and everyone moves toward the camera together, so all three photos should be shot at a similar distance and framing — mixing a closeup with a fullbody shot is the most common reason a render looks stitched. Your order stays fixed for the whole clip. If you rerender later, the same photo keeps the same position. Three People, Two People, or a Full Chipettes LineUp — Chipmunks AI Video The trend is built for three. That's the default here, and the slots are labelled by position instead of by colour, so you're not forced into one casting. Trio — the standard version: three friends, three siblings, three roommates. Duo — two people instead of three, with the middle and left slots filled and the middle dancer opening and closing. Useful when one of your three is in another city. Righttoleft swap — if your loudest friend belongs on the left, put them there. The template reads positions, not personalities. Colour is yours to choose. Red, blue and green is the casting everyone recognises, but it isn't required, and it isn't something this tool repaints — wear it in the photos and it carries through. What You Get — AI Dance Video Generator Specs Short Full Full HD Length opening routine full routine full routine Resolution 480p 480p 720p Aspect 9:16 9:16 9:16 Audio silent MP4 silent MP4 silent MP4 Watermark none none none Time to render a few minutes longer — two passes longest — two passes Vertical 9:16 works asshot on TikTok, Reels and Shorts. Nothing is cropped on upload. What This Tool Won’t Do Worth saying plainly, because a lot of chipmunk videos promise it: It won't animate Alvin, Simon or Theodore. This is a tool for your own photos. Uploading stills of the film characters, or asking for the characters' faces, isn't supported and isn't permitted. It won't let you upload other people. Only yourself and people who have explicitly agreed. No strangers, no children, no actors from the films. It won't write the choreography for you. The routine is a template. If you want a different dance, that's a different template. It doesn't bundle the recording. Sound comes from the platform's music library at posting time. Photos, Permissions, Privacy Every photo of a person is a permission question before it's a rendering question. Upload only your own photos and photos of adults who have said yes to this specific video. Uploads are private, used to render your video, and never used to train models. Deleting your video deletes the source photos with it. Nothing is published anywhere by us — posting is your call, from your own account. Pricing Credits, bought once. No subscription, and credits don't expire. Packs on this site are Creator, Pro, and Studio. Short, Full, and Full HD use different credit amounts — the generator shows the required credits before you run. Failed renders return credits automatically to your balance. Unused credit purchases may be refundable within 7 calendar days — see the [Refund Policy](/refundpolicy). Full pack prices are on [Pricing](/pricing). Chipmunks Dance AI FAQ How many photos do I need? Three, one per person — the chipmunk dance video generator default. items.title: Show HN: AgentFirstStack – analytics, tags, email and replay your agent sets up
items.desc: AgentFirstStack Infrastructure your agent sets up by itself: web analytics, tag management with serverside conversion tracking, email inboxes and session replay. No signup form, no verification email, no dashboard to click through. Free to use, and open source (MIT). Manual for agents: https://agentfirststack.com/llms.txt Registration and credentials: https://agentfirststack.com/auth.md Source: https://github.com/StartGlobalAI/agentfirststack How it works 1. Paste one prompt. It tells your agent where the manual is. 2. Your agent does the setup. One request (POST https://agentfirststack.com/v1/signup) gets a key that works on every service. No email, password or verification. 3. You approve what only you can. Your ad accounts stay yours; the agent asks for the exact IDs and tokens it needs from Google Ads, Meta or TikTok, and tells you where to find them. 4. Claim it when you like. The agent gives you a claim link. Sign in with Google to see the project's sites, containers and inboxes in a dashboard, manage keys, invite teammates and connect Claude or ChatGPT (https://agentfirststack.com/mcp as a custom connector, over OAuth). Services Service What it does Instead of Manual Analytics Countries, regions and cities from the edge; pages, sources and campaigns including AI assistants; goals, revenue, funnels, realtime; serverside events; no cookies Google Analytics https://analytics.agentfirststack.com/llms.txt Tags One snippet for every pixel; conversions sent from the browser and your server to GA4, Google Ads, Meta and TikTok with one event id, so each counts it once; click IDs kept; preview, publish, roll back Google Tag Manager https://tags.agentfirststack.com/llms.txt Mail Inboxes in one request; verification codes and links extracted; read, reply, send; your own domain; webhooks A Gmail account per project https://mail.agentfirststack.com/llms.txt Replay Session recordings masked in the browser by default; sessions as readable transcripts; rage, dead and error clicks; heatmaps and JS errors as data Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity https://replay.agentfirststack.com/llms.txt MCP One server for every service (tools prefixed analytics_, tags_, mail_, replay_): sh claude mcp add transport http afs https://agentfirststack.com/mcp header "Authorization: Bearer $AGENTFIRSTSTACK_API_KEY" Or one per service at https://<service.agentfirststack.com/mcp. Prompt for your agent text Set up AgentFirstStack for this project. Read https://agentfirststack.com/llms.txt first; it is the complete manual. If .env already has AGENTFIRSTSTACK_API_KEY, use it; otherwise get a key with POST https://agentfirststack.com/v1/signup and save it there. Then set up analytics, conversion tracking and an inbox, verifying each step, and note what you set up in AGENTFIRSTSTACK.md (ids and env var names, never key values). Ask me only for ad platform IDs and tokens. Finish with POST https://agentfirststack.com/v1/claimlink and give me the claim link it returns. Tell me what you set up and what still needs me. Free and open source Hosted: free, with fairuse limits listed in the manual. Selfhost: pnpm afs init <name domain example.com account <id then pnpm afs deploy <name. Guides and comparisons (for people) All of them: https://agentfirststack.com/guides Add analytics with Claude Code: https://agentfirststack.com/guides/addanalyticswithclaudecode Serverside conversion tracking for Meta, Google Ads, TikTok and GA4: https://agentfirststack.com/guides/serversideconversiontracking Email inbox for AI agents: receive verification codes by API: https://agentfirststack.com/guides/emailinboxforaiagents Session replay for AI agents: sessions as text, over an API: https://agentfirststack.com/guides/sessionreplayforaiagents AgentFirstStack MCP servers and tools: https://agentfirststack.com/mcp Google Analytics MCP compared with AgentFirstStack: https://agentfirststack.com/googleanalyticsmcp PostHog MCP compared with AgentFirstStack: https://agentfirststack.com/posthogmcp Mixpanel MCP compared with AgentFirstStack: https://agentfirststack.com/mixpanelmcp Google Tag Manager MCP compared with AgentFirstStack Tags: https://agentfirststack.com/googletagmanagermcp AgentMail alternative: inboxes your agent creates itself: https://agentfirststack.com/agentmailalternative Gmail MCP: what it does, and when an agent needs its own inbox: https://agentfirststack.com/gmailmcp Microsoft Clarity MCP: what it returns, and replay built for agents: https://agentfirststack.com/microsoftclaritymcp
items.author: cod3boy
items.descZh: AgentFirstStack 是一个面向 AI Agent 的基础设施平台，核心目标是让 Agent 自主完成网站分析、标签管理、邮件和会话回放等服务的配置，无需人工注册、验证或操作仪表盘。平台提供分析、标签、邮件、回放四项核心服务，通过一次 POST 请求即可获取跨服务通用的 API 密钥，并支持 MCP 协议与 Claude、ChatGPT 等模型集成。其亮点在于完全消除传统 SaaS 的注册流程，用户只需提供广告平台 ID 和令牌即可完成授权，且平台免费开源（MIT 协议），支持自托管。该方案特别适合需要快速部署监控体系的 AI Agent 开发者，或希望将分析工具集成到自动化工作流中的技术团队。
items.quote: 无需注册表单，无需验证邮件，也无需浏览仪表盘。

items.author: kagen
items.descZh: 在多租户SaaS应用中，数据隔离和数据库扩展是常见痛点，传统方案往往需要修改应用代码或引入复杂中间件。该开源代理通过透明路由层实现每个租户独立PostgreSQL数据库，应用无需任何更改即可自动识别租户并路由查询。核心功能包括动态租户发现、SQL查询重写和自动负载均衡，基于轻量级协议减少性能损耗。亮点在于实测查询延迟仅增加0.3ms，支持每秒8000次以上查询吞吐，并提供内置故障转移和加密传输。适用于需要快速构建多租户架构的初创企业、SaaS平台及微服务环境，尤其适合无法重构现有代码的场景。

items.descZh: PROJECT 24 是一个开放的游戏索引项目，专门收集和整理 Hacker News 上用户讨论的各种游戏，旨在将社区中零散的游戏相关对话系统化。其核心功能是提供一个可浏览的游戏列表，并附有指向原始讨论的链接，方便用户追溯对话上下文和了解社区观点。虽然原文未提供具体的收录数量或性能数字，但该项目的价值在于将分散的讨论转化为可查询的开放资源，降低了信息检索成本。适用场景包括追踪 Hacker News 上的游戏趋势、了解社区对特定游戏的评价，以及为游戏开发者和爱好者提供市场洞察和灵感来源。
items.quote: Hacker News 上讨论的游戏。一个包含原始对话链接的游戏开放索引。

items.author: tsvillain
items.descZh: Dryplate 是一款完全在浏览器端运行的免费图片处理工具，主打隐私保护，所有文件处理均在本地设备完成，无需上传、注册或面对广告。它提供了一套全面的图像编辑功能，包括 HEIC 转 JPG、格式转换、压缩、调整尺寸、裁剪、旋转、模糊、加水印、合并图片以及元数据管理等。其核心亮点在于零上传带来的即时处理体验，大多数照片在几秒内即可完成，且支持每次最多 50 张图片的批量操作，无水印、无每日限额。这款工具特别适合注重隐私的摄影师、社交媒体运营者以及日常需要快速处理手机照片的普通用户。
items.quote: 文件绝不会离开你的设备。

items.title: Show HN: Droneship – sandbox for your coding agents
items.desc: We want to share our latest project called Project Droneship ( https://www.droneship.run ) that lets you run claude code directly in a cloud sandbox. You can continue to work on the terminal just like you run normal claude. Droneship also supports Codex, Gemini etc., so a single CLI to run
items.author: sharathr
items.descZh: Project Droneship 是一项创新的云端沙箱项目，允许开发者直接在云端隔离的安全环境中运行 Claude Code。用户无需改变原有的终端操作习惯，即可像使用本地 Claude 一样进行无缝交互。该项目的一大亮点是不仅支持 Claude，还集成了 Codex、Gemini 等多种主流 AI 模型，提供了一个统一的 CLI 入口。这种架构极大地简化了多模型切换的复杂度，提升了开发与测试效率。它非常适合需要高隔离性云端开发环境，以及追求多模型协同工作的开发者和团队。
items.quote: 让你可以在云沙箱中直接运行 Claude Code
items.titleZh: 展示项目：Droneship——编程智能体的沙箱环境
